messages:
Maya: Dropped a quick mock for invite flow + role-selection handoff: https://figma.com/file/alpha Ethan: Saw it. Main friction: role descriptions hidden behind an ellipsis — users in research missed which permissions a role grants Ravi: Suggest inline mini-summary under role name (1 line) and a chevron to expand details. Keyboard expand should be possible via Enter/Space Zoe: A11y: expanded content needs aria-hidden=false when open and aria-expanded on the button. Also add aria-describedby linking header -> summary Cal: Invite tokeniser note: when pasting 50 emails we should parse and show a summary toast: "Parsed 50, 4 invalid" with link to details Maya: Proposed toast snippet: ```
Parsed 50 addresses, 4 invalid
``` Ethan: Debounce that so SRs don't get flooded on each keystroke Ravi: Copy nit: SSO toggle label currently 'Require SSO' prefer 'Enforce SSO login' and sublabel 'All users / Admins only' Zoe: Also accessibility nit: tab order in the drawer skips the role list and focuses footer buttons. Need focus to the first interactive inside drawer on open Cal: UX: deep-link from a role row -> open audit side-panel filtered to that role, but keep the roles list visible behind it (side-by-side) Maya: Agree. Also when opening audit we should briefly pulse/highlight the source row for 1.2s so users connect context Ethan: I'll file ENG-13790 for focus trap + highlight animation a11y-bot: Reminder: checklist updated: invite-tokeniser-aria, role-summary-accessible, audit-sidepanel-focus Ravi: Next steps: Maya updates Figma with inline summaries + aria notes, Zoe will run keyboard/SR pass in staging, Ethan owns ENG ticket, Cal will spec toast debounce and preview link
